system.description: You whistle a low, thrumming note that softens wood and stone like clay.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, but the shape is permanent.
outcomes.success: You reshape non-living natural material (fallen logs, vines, boulders) into simple tools, bridges or shelters. They are sturdy, but revert to their natural state after 24 hours.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails; the material will not move.
outcomes.ruin: The shape holds for an hour, then collapses at the worst possible moment. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
